name: Compact Sidewalk Strip
description: Narrow São Paulo pedestrian sidewalk planting strip (< 1.5 m wide) beneath low-voltage overhead distribution wires, surrounded by concrete pavement and compacted urban subsoil.

requirements.municipal_reference: Portaria SVMA nº 26/2024 & Plano Municipal de Arborização Urbana (PMAU)

ecological_goals: Pedestrian thermal comfort without Enel distribution wire conflicts
Urban pollinator stepping-stone corridor for native stingless bees

name: Sunny Degraded Lot
description: Open, sun-exposed degraded vacant parcel or pocket park (20–50 m²) without overhead utility wires, requiring rapid canopy closure, nitrogen/organic matter recovery, and soil stabilization.
ecological_goals: Rapid pioneer canopy nucleating microclimate cooling (urban heat island mitigation)
Topsoil decompaction, leaf-litter generation, and erosion control
High-nectar and zoochoric fruit production to attract urban birds and pollinators

name: Shaded Courtyard
description: Protected residential, school, or community courtyard (15–30 m²) framed by mid-rise buildings with filtered light to deep shade, moderate soil volume, and no overhead utility lines.

requirements.municipal_reference: Portaria SVMA nº 26/2024, BioSampa (5ª Edição) & PMAU

ecological_goals: Multi-strata Atlantic Forest understory establishment under low-lux conditions
Year-round native berry and nectar resources for urban avifauna and hummingbirds
Quiet community biodiversity pocket aligned with UN SDG Target 11.7
